headline: 1 vault address confirmed on Ethereum; Morpho vaults, Kamino/Lista/Midas vaults exist but addresses not extracted; block explorers and GitHub blocked

D2: Website (rockawayx.com) fetched successfully; no 'Deployed contracts' or 'Addresses' page found. Protocol website is a marketing/VC site with no on-chain address registry. deployed_contracts_doc set to null.
D3: No audit_links provided in per-protocol context. No audit reports discovered from website or search. Zero addresses from this source.

rationale.verdict: Incomplete discovery — only 1 vault address (Upshift ctUSD, Ethereum) could be traced to a fetched URL. RockawayX is a vault curator on Morpho, Upshift, Kamino, Lista DAO, and Midas across 6 chains, but block explorers and GitHub were blocked or absent, and no official deployments doc exists. Morpho's curator metadata API was also blocked. Further runs should attempt the DeFiPunkd surfacer for 0xc87DBBB8C67e4F19fCD2E297c05937567b2572Ce and search the Morpho Blue API for the curator's address set.

evidence.shows: RockawayX homepage confirms the protocol is a VC/liquidity/infrastructure firm operating as an on-chain liquidity provider and vault curator. No deployed contract addresses listed.

Article confirms RockawayX vault curation surpassed $100M TVL. References curated vaults on Upshift (Earn ctUSD, address 0xc87DBBB8C67e4F19fCD2E297c05937567b2572Ce on Ethereum chain 1), Morpho (3 vaults), Kamino Finance (Solana), Lista DAO (BNB), and Midas (mROX). Confirms RockawayX is 9th on DeFiLlama curator rankings.

protocol_metadata.about: RockawayX is a blockchain-focused venture capital and liquidity firm that operates as a vault curator on DeFi protocols including Morpho, Upshift, Kamino Finance, Lista DAO, and Midas. Users deposit assets into ERC-4626-compatible vaults where RockawayX acts as curator and allocator, setting risk parameters and managing capital allocation across multiple lending markets. The firm also operates as a solver for intent-based cross-chain protocols (Wormhole Settlement, deBridge, Mayan Swap) and runs proof-of-stake validators across 50+ networks. As of May 2026, RockawayX vault curation has surpassed $100M in TVL across Ethereum, Solana, and BNB Chain.
